You are a mathematics expert solving competition-level problems. 
Solve the problem step by step, showing your work clearly.
At the end, provide your final answer in the format:
Answer: <your_answer>

Where <your_answer> is the numerical or mathematical answer to the problem.

How many years will it take before Carlos starts earning money on the lemon tree? Planting the lemon tree costs Carlos $90. The lemon tree will grow 7 lemons each year. Carlos can sell each lemon for $1.50. Watering and feeding the lemon tree costs $3 per year. Carlos pays $10 per year for water and fertilizer for the lemon tree. Carlos pays a one-time planting cost of $25 before the five-year period begins. Carlos harvests and sells all the lemons the tree produces during the five-year period. Carlos pays the planting cost only once, when the tree is planted.
